name: Wikimedia Commons
recommended_use: Historical exact-match or team-specific football footage when an acceptable licence is shown on the file page.
notes: Licence terms differ by file. Record author, source URL, licence and attribution.

name: YouTube Creative Commons
recommended_use: Historical football footage only when the video is explicitly under Creative Commons Attribution and rights provenance is credible.
notes: Standard YouTube licence is not reusable permission. Preserve title, author, URL and CC BY attribution.

name: Vimeo Creative Commons
recommended_use: Historical/team footage carrying a suitable Creative Commons licence.
notes: Reject NC licences for commercial MDRN SportsQ use; reject ND where editing is required.

name: Europeana
recommended_use: Historical archive material with clear Public Domain / CC / rights statement permitting intended reuse.
notes: Every digital object has a rights statement. Treat In Copyright as blocked unless permission exists.

name: Pexels
notes: Free use including commercial/social use; check trademarks, brands and identifiable people.

name: Pixabay
notes: Do not redistribute standalone content; trademarks/logos and other third-party rights can still apply.

name: Coverr
notes: Commercial use is allowed, but brands/trademarks/identifiable properties may require separate permission.

name: Mixkit
notes: Only Mixkit Stock Video Free License is acceptable for commercial MDRN SportsQ use. Restricted License is blocked.
